title: The Hasse diagram of divisibility on {1, 2, 3, 6}
caption: Only covering pairs are drawn: 1 is covered by 2 and by 3, and each of those by 6. The edge from 1 to 6 is left out because 2 lies between, so the diagram is a diamond.
alt: A diamond: 1 at the bottom, 2 and 3 in the middle and 6 at the top, with four edges and no edge from 1 straight to 6.
description: List the pairs a | b with nothing strictly between them: (1, 2), (1, 3), (2, 6), (3, 6).
Draw 1 at the bottom and 6 at the top, with 2 and 3 between.
Join each covering pair by an edge going upwards.
1 | 6 is not drawn: it follows from the path through 2.

checks.name: divisibility on {1, 2, 3, 6} has exactly 4 covering pairs
2 and 3 sit level: neither divides the other

fromLesson: the Hasse diagram is a diamond
